title: FormTemplate
description: An annotation file describing where every box on a U.S. tax form is, how it's formatted, and which value from a taxpayer's data belongs in it. See SPEC.md.

formId.description: Stable identifier for the form, e.g. "W-2", "1099-INT", "F1040".

formVersion.description: Tax year the layout matches, e.g. "2024". Forms are revised yearly.

issuingAgency.description: Agency that publishes this form's official layout.

sourceDocument.description: URL or citation for the official IRS/SSA PDF this annotation's positions and labels were measured from, e.g. "https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/fw2.pdf". Lets a reviewer trace every box back to its origin; see SPEC.md §5.

pages.description: Physical page geometry, one entry per page of the form.

fields.description: One entry per printable box, or per repeating box template.

Unit.description: pt (1/72 in) is the normalized internal unit; in/mm are legal for authoring convenience.

referenceImageUrl.description: Path or URL to a rasterized image of this page (matching `width`/`height`), for visually overlaying `position` boxes during review. Not used by the resolver.

Position.description: Top-left origin, x increasing right, y increasing down. Measured directly off the form's official published layout.

negativeStyle.description: currency, number. minus: "-100.00". parentheses: "(100.00)" (accounting style). redText: renderer hint only, no ASCII change.

literalValue.description: Required when type is "literal": static form text, not taxpayer data.

path.description: JSONPath-lite expression into the taxpayer's data document. Supports dot access, array indices, [*] wildcards, and [?(@.field==value)] filters.

aggregate.description: Collapses a wildcard/filter match to one value. Omit when path already resolves to a single value.

fallback.description: Value to use when path resolves to nothing, e.g. 0, "", or null.

ConditionalSpec.description: Box is skipped entirely (not laid out) unless the comparison against path evaluates true. Exactly one comparison operator is expected alongside path.

sourcePath.description: Path to the array being iterated, e.g. "$.income.w2Forms".

rowHeight.description: Offset applied per row, in the position's unit.

maxRows.description: How many rows the physical form has room for.

id.description: Unique within the form, stable across formVersion revisions. Convention: <formId>.<box>.<shortName>, dot-separated segments (camelCase or lowercase within a segment).

formLine.description: The form's own label for the box, copied verbatim from the official form, e.g. "Box 1".

allOf.description: dataBinding is required unless format.type is "literal" (static text with no taxpayer value).
